Conceptual architecture based on the project description in my resume.

Overview

Weather conditions influence launch suitability. The capstone explored how prepared weather data and machine learning models could support that classification task.

What I built

Developed a Python machine learning solution using H2O AutoML and Scikit-learn to prepare weather data, train models, and evaluate predictive performance.

  • Prepared weather data for machine learning.
  • Trained and compared models with H2O AutoML and Scikit-learn.
  • Evaluated predictive performance for launch-condition suitability.

Outcome

A capstone workflow covering data preparation, model comparison, and evaluation. This academic project is not an operational launch-safety system.
